meta.name: onboarding
meta.description: Guides a first-time omo user through setup and the core workflow. Use when a new user asks to get started with omo.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 完成首次设置,跑通核心流程。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚拿到 omo,不知道第一步该做什么。
copy.tagline_en: Finish first-time setup and run through the core workflow.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just got omo and don't know the first step.

howto.what: 首次使用 omo 时,Claude 会按顺序带你走六个环节:功能导览、迁移帮助、历史会话分析、价值映射、记忆记录和首次 init-deep 提议;其中三个环节要你同意才进行,并用你的语言回复。
howto.when: 当新用户提出想开始使用 omo 时触发。该导览一生只自动启动一次,可用 `senpi --onboard` 重新调出,或用 `omo-senpi-onboarding-disabled` 关闭自动启动。

say.text: 我是新用户,带我过一遍 omo 吧
say.note: 进入功能导览及其后环节

say.text: 我从 Claude Code 迁过来,能帮我把配置搬过来吗
say.note: 扫描现有配置并给出迁移方案,等你确认

say.text: 看看我以前那些编码会话吧
say.note: 读取历史会话并总结你的工作模式

howto.what_en: On first use, Claude walks a new omo user through six lanes: feature tour, migration help, session archaeology, value mapping, memory recording and an init-deep proposal. Three are opt-in; it replies in the user's language.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a new user asks to get started with omo. The tour auto-starts only once; bring it back with the `senpi --onboard` flag or turn auto-start off with `omo-senpi-onboarding-disabled`.

say_en.text: I'm new to omo, walk me through it
say_en.note: Starts the feature tour and following lanes

say_en.text: I'm coming from Claude Code, can you carry my setup over?
say_en.note: Shows a migration plan and waits for your OK

say_en.text: Take a look at my past coding sessions
say_en.note: Reads session history and summarizes your patterns
